notes: health = WOUNDS column from text/Combat.pdf Monster Reference analysis sheet (owner-verified); distinct from fortitude which only sets combat hand size.

monsters.name: Crebain
monsters.ability: Spy: For each damage you would deal with a Ranged card, instead place 1 influence in extension of a Shadow Stronghold.

monsters.name: Agent
monsters.ability: Spread Lies: Once per battle, after you deal damage with a Ranged card, your opponent receives 1 Corruption card.

monsters.name: Snaga
monsters.ability: Precision: Your Ranged cards gain +1 attack.

monsters.name: Orc
monsters.ability: Fanatical: If both you and your opponent play Melee cards, deal your opponent 1 damage.

monsters.name: Barrow Wight
monsters.ability: Regenerate: At the end of a combat round, if you were not defeated and you played a Ranged card, heal 1 damage.

monsters.name: Southron
monsters.ability: Superior Tactics: Reduce the strength cost of your Melee cards by 1 (to a minimum of 0)

monsters.name: Dunlending
monsters.ability: Counter-attack: When you prevent at least 1 damage with the defense value of your Melee card, deal your opponent 1 damage.

monsters.name: Uruk-Hai
monsters.ability: Bloodfury: When you deal damage with a Melee card, you may draw a Combat card.

monsters.name: Warg Rider
monsters.ability: Surprise Assault: If the bottom card of your combat stack is a Melee card, reduce its strength cost to 0.

monsters.name: Giant Spider
monsters.ability: Paralyzing Venom: When you deal at least 2 damage with a Melee card, your opponent must randomly discard a card from his hand.

monsters.name: Huorn
monsters.ability: Crushing Strength: Your Melee cards gain +1 attack.

monsters.name: Cave Troll
monsters.ability: Roar: When you play a Ranged card, your opponent's Melee card is canceled.

monsters.name: Oliphaunt
monsters.ability: Stampede: When you deal damage with a Melee card, at least 1 of the damage must be discarded from your opponent's hand.

monsters.name: Balrog
monsters.ability: Fear: When you deal at least 3 damage with a Melee card, your opponent must play a random Combat card next round.
